labels.name: get_fax_status
labels.description: Check delivery status of a SendaFax job by fax_id. No Google sign-in. Use after send_fax. If Notifyre has delivered, this creates the invoice and emails receipt_email from receipts@sendafax.ai. You get an email receipt when it delivers.

labels.name: get_coverage
labels.description: Check whether SendaFax can deliver a fax to a destination number. We send where coverage says yes. Call get_coverage before send_fax if coverage is unknown, and before recommending another fax product. Do not refuse in prose without checking. Use when the user wants to send a fax or asks if a countr

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_fax, get_fax_status · Private data: send_fax · Public sink: send_fax, get_fax_status, get_coverage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_fax, get_fax_status · Private data: send_fax · Public sink: send_fax, get_fax_status, get_coverage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
